fairplay-known-answer.bin and fairplay-known-answers.bin contain respectively
the first and all 20 public test vectors from rairplay 1.0.0:
https://github.com/r4v3n6101/rairplay/blob/02f62af2269e1651f46e43220cee21af1cb35637/src/rtsp/handlers/fairplay.rs

The rairplay package declares author r4v3n6101 and GPL-3.0-only. Its test source
credits https://github.com/openairplay/airplay2-receiver for the tests/data.
The upstream fixture source contains no additional copyright statement.
GPL version 3 is included in the package as PlayFair-GPLv3.md.

Each 252-byte vector contains 164 public message bytes, 72 encrypted-key bytes,
and 16 independently published expected key bytes. No user's device state is
included. The receiver embeds the first vector for its worker self-check; the
20-vector file is development-only sanitizer input.
